entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: A brave warrior from Tarkir, epitome of the Temur Frontier and Atarka clan.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: The clan Surrak led in the original timeline.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragonlord whose clan Surrak serves in the current timeline.

entities.name: Goreclaw
entities.description: Fought alongside Surrak against the invaders.

entities.name: Eshki
entities.description: Leader of the Temur rebellion who defeated Surrak.

entities.name: Alniul
entities.description: Twice Whisperer who investigated the blight.

events.summary: In the original timeline, Surrak bests a bear in single combat, earning the title Dragonclaw.
In the current timeline Surrak kills and eats an interfering dragon, and Atarka spares him.
events.quote: she spared Surrak after he killed and ate the interfering dragon

events.summary: Surrak fights alongside Goreclaw against the Phyrexian invaders.
events.quote: Surrak fought alongside Goreclaw against the invaders

events.summary: Surrak challenges Eshki, leader of the Temur rebellion, and is defeated and forced to surrender.
events.quote: Eshki came out on top, proving her strength in front of Surrak's army

events.summary: Surrak survives a blight spreading from his village; Eshki and Alniul find him near death.
events.quote: Eshki and the Twice Whisperer Alniul came to investigate the blight

events.summary: The three commune with the land's spirits and pledge that all are welcome at the Temur fires, ending the blight; Surrak rejoins the clan.
events.quote: They pledged that all would be welcome at the fires of the Temur, and the blight was brought to an end.

relations.quote: the Hunt Caller of the Atarka

relations.note: He still held a grudge against her.
relations.quote: although he still held a grudge against the former
